description: Deterministic rules evaluated against normalized facility facts. Rules create explained POTENTIAL candidates only; they never confirm a source or calculate emissions.

evaluation_contract.condition_scope: All conditions in one rule apply to the same normalized fact record.
evaluation_contract.merge_behavior: Merge candidate origins and reasons without discarding any triggering rule ID.

suggestion.reason: Purchased grid electricity is reported as consumed by the facility.

follow_up_questions: Are complete electricity bills or meter records available for the reporting period?
Is any onsite generation, exported electricity or purchased renewable electricity recorded separately?

suggestion.reason: Purchased {{energy_type}} is reported as consumed by the facility.

follow_up_questions: Who supplies the energy service and in what unit is it billed?
Does the supplier provide a reviewed emission factor and boundary description?

suggestion.reason: {{equipment_type}} is reported with {{fuel_type}} as a fuel input.

follow_up_questions: Is this equipment owned or operationally controlled by the company?
What quantity of {{fuel_type}} was consumed during the reporting period?
Are equipment-specific fuel records available?
What fuel quantity or distance record is available for the reporting period?
Is the activity already included in another fuel record?

suggestion.reason: Refrigeration or cooling equipment is present, so refrigerant leakage must be reviewed.

follow_up_questions: What refrigerant type and charge does each system use?
Was refrigerant added, recovered, disposed of or transferred during the reporting period?
Are service and maintenance records available?

suggestion.reason: The {{process_name}} process may directly release greenhouse gases apart from fuel combustion.

follow_up_questions: Which greenhouse gas is released and by what mechanism?
What process activity or material-balance data is available?

suggestion.reason: {{material_type}} is reported as a purchased material, packaging item or chemical.

follow_up_questions: What quantity was purchased during the reporting period?
Is material specification, recycled content or supplier-specific emissions data available?

suggestion.reason: A third party transports purchased goods or materials upstream of the facility.

follow_up_questions: Who arranges and pays for the transport service?
What mass, distance, route and transport-mode data is available?

suggestion.reason: A third party transports or distributes products downstream of the facility.

follow_up_questions: Who arranges and pays for the transport service?
What mass, distance, route and transport-mode data is available?

suggestion.reason: {{waste_type}} generated by the facility is sent for external treatment.

follow_up_questions: What quantity was sent to each treatment route?
Is the final treatment route supported by contractor evidence?

suggestion.reason: Wastewater generated by the facility is reported as treated onsite.

follow_up_questions: What treatment technology and wastewater volume apply?
Are COD, BOD, methane-recovery and sludge records available?

suggestion.reason: Wastewater generated by the facility is reported as treated offsite.

follow_up_questions: What volume and treatment route apply?
Is the treatment destination supported by a utility or contractor record?

suggestion.reason: {{activity_type}} is performed by a third party outside direct operational control.

follow_up_questions: Which supplier performs the activity and what quantity of output or service is purchased?
Is supplier-specific emissions information available?

suggestion.reason: Equipment contains a gas that may be released during use, maintenance or an incident.

follow_up_questions: Which gases are present and are they greenhouse gases?
What inventory, refill, transfer or incident records are available?
